title: Fruit Punch E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Getting your regular fix of CBD just got a whole lot smoother with our latest addition: Fruit Punch CBD E-liquid. Vaping your CBD is a simple with our specially crafted blend, perfect for those on the move. Just fill up your vape and you’re good to go, making it simple to keep up with your CBD routine, wherever you are. Our blend boasts an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) mix, ensuring each vape is smooth.
Pop your vape in your pocket or bag, and you’re all set to enjoy the lush, fruity flavours and the calming benefits of CBD anytime, anywhere. With SupremeCBD, staying on top of your own wellness has never been easier or more enjoyable.
